summary: Broad pivot-zone magnet/stall/reversal hypotheses still failed, but a narrower daily/weekly pivot-proximity terminal-hazard effect survived internal falsification and was promoted—unchanged—to protected holdout confirmation.
robustness: Daily normalized spatial gradient was monotonic: 32.76%, 31.98%, 31.07%, 30.16%, 30.09% from nearest to farthest 10%-wide bins.
Same-geometry high/low robustness remained positive for daily and weekly.
Named-level non-dominance and leave-one-pair-out checks passed for promoted daily/weekly S5 effects.
limitations: The endpoint is a retrospectively confirmed ATR-defined terminal extreme. It is not yet a causal reversal entry or trading strategy.
Broad attraction, target, stall and reversal claims remain rejected.
Internal data through 2021 were used to discover/validate the narrowed terminal-hazard mechanism; the protected 2022-2025 confirmation is still required.
authorized_next: One separately preregistered 2022-2025 holdout confirmation of the exact unchanged daily/weekly terminal-zone mechanism.
prohibited_next: Do not convert the retrospective terminal label directly into an entry rule.
Do not optimize zone width, pair subset, timeframe or endpoint before the protected confirmation.

assurance.decision: Independent assurance PASS on the frozen internal study.
